business_problem: democratize data and personalize member journeys across a global fitness portfolio while reducing infrastructure cost and manual pipeline work.
solution_summary: RSG Group uses Snowflake, Cortex AI, and Power BI on Snowflake to democratize data and personalize member journeys across a global fitness portfolio while reducing infrastructure cost and manual pipeline work. Customer, product, transaction, and campaign data are centralized in Snowflake so marketing, merchandising, and customer-experience teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Cortex AI adds in-platform LLM and agentic capabilities for classification, summarization, retrieval, or natural-language analytics on top of the curated data foundation. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. RSG Group achieved 10x Speed to insight supports new products and timely customer interventions and 20x Lower TCO compared to RSG’s previous infrastructure.
